purpose: Official Table 1 selection stage; no validation or test data is read

el2n.description: Top EL2N score from early training dynamics

facility.description: Per-class full cosine facility location with balanced quotas

graph_a2.description: Original global Graph-A2: K = A_hat + A_hat^2

assumptions: Paper Table 2 identifies k=50: its Blood and OrganS values exactly match the Table 1 Graph-A2 column; Graph-A2 therefore uses a global k=50 graph with H=2.
Facility remains per-class because the paper does not unambiguously establish its graph scope; a top-level global flag would also change Facility in the public runner.
Training-dynamics scoring follows the repository implementation: 28x28, 200 epochs, window size 10.
The paper says trials vary training seeds; this runner also varies selection seeds for Random and FPS, matching the official runner behavior.
Effective budget is floor(floor(n_train * ratio) / n_classes) per class, as in the official runner.
